sampleOrder: row-major, top-left to bottom-right; 12 RGB triplets per frame
sampleMethod: Decode final showreel at native 640x480 RGB24. Convert each display sRGB pixel to linear light with IEC sRGB transfer, area-average each 160x160 cell, then encode the mean as sRGB rounded to five decimals. No spatial downscale before linearization.
timing: Frame n at n/30 seconds. Hard cuts at frames 60,120,180,240,300; loop at 360. Each source interval is exactly 2 seconds, rendered as 60 frames.
